contract.title: R0.2: Execute the tuning-only Phase-0 baseline capture in a verified detached worktree
contract.invariant: Capture executes only inside a verified detached worktree whose capture cwd and tree digest equal the frozen base ($BASELINE_COMMIT/$BASELINE_TREE_SHA256); held-out partition is denied (--deny-heldout); the receipt proves the executed HEAD/tree equals the frozen base (plan §7.5 R0.2 row, §7.6 R0.2 row).
production_callers: scripts/run-ranking-v3-baseline-capture.mjs (R0.1V-owned wrapper) invoking scripts/satori-search-candidate-capture.mjs (existing; parseArgs with --out, ~:1221-1257) against evals/search-ranking/cross-repository-v3.manifest.json (existing; 6 tuning + 6 held-out partitions)
downstream consumers: B8 (pre-instrumentation byte-identity baseline) and B9 (corpus manifest binding)
test_callers: scripts/satori-search-candidate-capture.test.mjs (existing, unaffected; verified at base: 34/34 pass, exit 0)
interface_changes: tuning-only Phase-0 baseline evidence under $TASK_OUTPUT/evidence plus detached worktree at $TASK_OUTPUT/worktree
baseline receipt proving capture process ran at baselineCommit and baselineTreeSha256 with held-out denied
security_boundaries: detached-worktree execution isolation: capture cwd and tree digest must equal the frozen base; the wrapper never runs capture from the caller worktree (R0.1V RED test)
held-out partition denied (--deny-heldout); the v3 manifest's 6 held-out entries must never be captured in Phase-0
overlap_with: FT-B (R0.2 is the pre-instrumentation byte-identity baseline for B8; plan edge B8: R0.2)
R0.1/R0.1V (baseline commit/tree and wrapper come from their receipts/tooling)
contract.instructions: Execution card per §7.6 (unmet-precondition: no detached verified baseline worktree exists; validating assertion: receipt proves capture process ran at baselineCommit and baselineTreeSha256, with held-out denied). The wrapper is plan-specified (R0.1V-owned) and does not exist at base — commands unverifiable-at-base. Do NOT modify scripts/satori-search-candidate-capture.mjs (exclusive owner B6, §7.1) or evals/search-ranking/cross-repository-v3.manifest.json (exists at base with 6 tuning + 6 held-out partitions; partition tuning with --deny-heldout selects tuning only). Baseline evidence must remain byte-stable: B8 later proves pre/post-instrumentation byte identity against this capture (FT-B). Run only after R0.1B card dispatch; $BASELINE_COMMIT/$BASELINE_TREE_SHA256 come from the R0.1 receipt.
